Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandfather” as the father of Albert II (i.e., the father’s grandfather) and concluded Albert I, even though the data showed John II’s father was Albert II. The correct paternal grandfather of Albert IV is Albert II, Prince of Anhalt-Zerbst (the father of his father, John II).
